description: A `canon-trigger/1` document as written: one rule.

Identifier.description: A well-formed identifier is not empty, and without whitespace, control characters or Unicode format characters (general category Cf). The pattern checks only for whitespace; Canon also refuses control and Unicode format characters.

TriggerRule.description: A `canon-trigger/1` document as written: one rule.

format.description: The document format; only `canon-trigger/1` is accepted.

version.description: The rule's version, a positive integer; a changed rule is a new version.

owner.description: Who answers for the rule, not empty. Canon does not resolve it.

where.description: One `canon-expr/1` expression of type Bool over `$row`, the record of the declared fields. Absent, every row in the state matches.

start.description: The protocol a match starts, and its case inputs.

mode.description: Whether a match is offered or would start the protocol.

access.description: The access class the rule expects of the protocol it starts.

refire.description: Whether a row fires again when it re-enters its state.

cap.description: Starts per rule per UTC day, a positive integer.

TriggerSubject.description: The rows a rule watches: their kind, the row fields the rule reads, and the state a row must be in.

kind.description: The kind of the rows, as the snapshot names it.

fields.description: The row fields the rule reads, keyed by field name; `$row` is a record of exactly these.

state.description: The state a row must be in.

TriggerStart.description: The protocol a match starts, and the case inputs it fills.

input.description: The case inputs, keyed by case input id; absent, none.

TriggerMode.description: Whether a match is offered for approval or would start the protocol.

TriggerAccess.description: The access class a rule expects of the protocol it starts.

TriggerRefire.description: Whether a row fires again after it leaves its state and re-enters it.

optional.description: Whether a row may lack the field; `false` when left out.

TriggerState.description: The state a row must be in: its field `field`, a declared required `string` field, equals `is`.

field.description: The declared field that holds the row's state.

is.description: The value the field holds when the row is in the state.

TriggerInput.description: The value of one case input. Written as a map with exactly one of the keys `field` or `const`.

field.description: The value of a declared row field.

TriggerFieldType.description: The type of a declared row field, and so of its entry in `$row`.
